intro: This ITC doctorate develops spatial-statistical methods for combining IoT measurements, remote sensing and field observations to understand diseases in tree crops. Cocoa farms in Ghana provide a central application.
description:
Project Overview

This ITC doctorate develops spatial-statistical methods for combining IoT measurements, remote sensing and field observations to understand diseases in tree crops. Cocoa farms in Ghana provide a central application.

Research Position Overview

Help establish a sensor network, handle misaligned and incomplete observations, and compare model transferability with tree crops in Dutch food forests. The work links statistical modelling with environmental field data.

Research Areas

  • Spatial and spatiotemporal statistics
  • IoT and Earth observation
  • Cocoa disease mapping
